_comment: Machine-readable copy of docs/spec/service-inputs.md. The kit and the registry read THIS file; they must stay in step with the prose. Additive only: never rename, never repurpose, never recycle a retired name. A group name alone (e.g. ship.address) is legal shorthand; a group with sub-fields also publishes the sub-fields it uses.

tag_contract.letters: carried on the existing single-letter t tag (ADR-0001 D2/D3); additions are new VALUES, never new letters
tag_contract.and_problem: several #t values in one REQ are OR, never AND. The relay filter is a coarse prefilter; the AND is done locally on the cache (ADR-0001 D6).

tiers.fulfilment: needed to deliver or to run the session
tiers.legal: required by law or by the venue's terms

tier_tag.rule: exactly ONE tier tag per announcement = the MAXIMUM tier among the declared cvm:req:*/cvm:opt:* fields
tier_tag.why_max_only: several #t values in one REQ are OR, so 'at most contact' = #t:[cvm:tier:none,cvm:tier:financial,cvm:tier:contact]. Publishing every tier present would make 'has no sensitive field' an absence test, which no relay filter can express.
tier_tag.conservative: a service is never matched by a filter looser than its worst field
tier_tag.truth: the field list is the truth; the tier tag MUST equal the recomputed max of the declared fields, and a reader finding a disagreement MUST use the recomputed value AND surface the mismatch
tier_tag.ladder_note: a disclosure ordering, not a juridical claim - rank 3 is not 'worse' than rank 2, it is higher in the upper-bound sense the filter needs

order.items.note: basket (line items + quantities); usually a tool argument, still declared

order.channel.note: the venue's own rail used for v1 deep-link

session.meter.note: e.g. kWh budget for a charge session

asset.id.note: charger / table / locker the user asks about

identity.age_over.note: bare assertion, preferred over a date of birth

identity.gov_id.note: avoid; MUST be visible in the announcement and badged in the dashboard

auth.membership_set.note: value is the set's 'a' reference, not a boolean; customer-side ring case, mirror of P12

payment.amount.note: unit MUST be declared (sats or fiat)

payment.method.note: v1: the venue's own rail settles (ADR-0001 D5)

rules: declare what the FLOW collects, not just what the CVM's own tool signature needs
minimisation: MUST NOT require a field it does not use
unknown fields fail loud: surface as unknown requirement, never count as cvm:req:none
absent is not none: no cvm:req:* tag at all = unknown appetite, grouped as unclassified
tags carry the filterable names; the announcement content carries types, patterns and explanations
